decisions.reason: The separate Wix-site architecture is already fully represented by the candidate's message 39 INTRODUCE Event.
The candidate already records the message 39 decision to isolate location payment setups through separate Wix websites and accounts.
Routing visitors to location sites does not change the existing role of the master site as the central source for brand, location, and general information.
The booking platform remains Wix, and the candidate already has a message 39 scope update covering Seattle and Bay Area location bookings.
The candidate already records message 39's reporting-isolation effect, while its booking and calendar isolation rules were already established.
The selected-location routing arrangement is compatible with future location integration but does not necessarily modify that reusable-growth requirement.
The routing decision does not change the SMASH ROOM brand name or its existing scope.
Location routing does not alter the established competitor-reference, simple-layout, or easy-navigation design requirements.
Message 39 does not establish any necessary change to the Bay Area SEO-preservation requirement.
